# analysis of case study: US-Umd and DE-Lnf medoid sites  
## part 4 - manipulating site ages experiment

```{r}
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::filter)
conflicts_prefer(here::here)

df_14 <- read_csv(here("data/main/14_pre_processing/df_ml_ready.csv"))
df_stats <- read_csv(here("data/main/27_case_study/stats.csv"))
df_preds <- read_csv(here("data/main/27_case_study/preds.csv"))
df_yearly <- read_csv(here("data/main/10_filtering2/df_yearly2.csv"))

```



```{r}
# standard error function
se <- function(x) {sd(x) / sqrt(length(x))}

# colours
pal = ltc(casa_natal)

# bar plot
p1 <- df_stats %>%
    
    # group by conditions
    group_by(site, model, shuffled) %>%
    
    # stats per combination
    summarise(mean_r2 = mean(r2),
              se_r2 = se(r2),
              sd_r2 = sd(r2),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    
    # plot bar chart with the fill as interaction between model and shuffles boolean value
    ggplot(aes(x = interaction(model, shuffled), y = mean_r2, fill = interaction(model, shuffled))) +
    
    # columns and standard error bars
    geom_col(position = "dodge", 
             width = 0.75, 
             alpha = 0.75,
             colour = "black", 
             linewidth = 0.2) +
    
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_r2 - se_r2, ymax = mean_r2 + se_r2),
                position = position_dodge(0.9), width = 0.2) +
    
    # aesthetics
    theme_bw() +
    ylab("R$^2$") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal, 
                      labels = c("Mod.FALSE" = "Mod",
                                  "Mod + Age.FALSE" = "Mod + Age",
                                  "Mod + Age.TRUE" = "Mod + Shuffled Age")) +
    
    # zoom y
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.75, 0.9)) +
    facet_wrap(~site) +
    xlab("") +
    theme(legend.position = "top", 
          axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_blank()) +
    labs(fill = "RF Model") 
    

p1

```

```{r}
summary_stats <- df_stats %>%
    
    # group by conditions
    group_by(site, model, shuffled) %>%
    
    # stats per combination
    summarise(mean_r2 = mean(r2),
              mean_mae = mean(mae),
              mean_rmse = mean(rmse),
              sd_r2 = sd(r2),
              .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}
# filter out non-training sites from .py scripts
site_col <- df_14 %>%
    filter(! Site_ID %in% c("CA-TP1", "CA-TP4", "US-Me2", "US-Me5", "US-Me6", "CH-Dav")) %>%
    select(Site_ID) 

# convert to list (def a better way to do this)
site_list <- unique(site_col$Site_ID)

# now filter yearly site data to these sites only
df_yearly_clean <- df_yearly %>%
    filter(Site_ID %in% site_list)


```


```{r}
p_age_et <- df_yearly_clean %>%
    
    group_by(Site_ID) %>%

    ggplot(aes(x = Site_age, y = ET_90D_peak_sum)) +
    
    theme_bw() +
    geom_point(aes(colour = Climate_zone, shape = Cover_type))+
    geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
    ylab("ET (mm/year)") +
    xlab("Site Age (years)") +
    #facet_wrap(~Climate_zone) +
    
    # add medoid ids
    geom_text_repel(aes(label = case_when(Site_ID %in% c("US-UMd", "DE-Lnf") ~ Site_ID)),
                min.segment.length = 2,
                force = 150,
                box.padding = 1.25)


p_age_et

```

```{r}
sum_et_age_lm <- lm(ET_year ~ Site_age, data = df_yearly_clean)
sum_et_peak_age_lm <- lm(ET_90D_peak_sum ~ Site_age, data = df_yearly_clean)
```
